title: Nocturnal Nutmeg Japanese Chicken Noodle Bowl
description: A smoky, savory, and satisfying Okinawan-inspired Japanese dish featuring chewy noodles, succulent chicken, and a hint of sweetness from the nutmeg. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: oklahoma-style flat rice noodles
ingredients.notes: soak in cold water for 30 minutes before cooking

instructions: Heat 1 tsp of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until smoking.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside, leaving the juices behind.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the grated ginger to the skillet and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the soaked noodles to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add the soy sauce, smoked paprika, nutmeg, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve hot.
